description: For a factor account's owner: every alert subscription on the account (id, channel, the host it goes to, rules, created, active, pending or off). Needs the owner's signed request for request "alerts-list".

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

name: factor_alerts_list
title: Factor accounts: the account's alert subscriptions
